hints.title: Compare with Removal Boundaries
hints.text: For each interval [start, end], compare its span with the removal window [rem_start, rem_end].

hints.title: Identify Disjoint Intervals
hints.text: If end <= rem_start or start >= rem_end, the interval is completely untouched and kept intact.

hints.title: Clip Overlapping Fragments
hints.text: If start < rem_start, append [start, rem_start]; if end > rem_end, append [rem_end, end].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rebuilding intervals through set operations or interval tree lookups is unnecessarily complex.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear scan clips each interval independently in O(1) time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle partial left, partial right, and full containment seamlessly.
complexity.notes: Intervals are disjoint and sorted initially.
